newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends mixed.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends mixed.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed mixed on Friday in special deals which moved prices sideways, operators said.

The special deals, which traders said had involved shares of high-caps bought at lower quotes, put turnover at 30.6 billion lei. Specials in larger volumes on Thursday had sent turnover to an all-time record of 57.6 billion lei.
RASDAQ, the Romanian equivalent of the OTC market, failled to supply details on special the deals.
Overall, closing prices of 90 stocks drifted higher on Friday, while 89 fell and 295 were unchanged.
Traders forecast a slight volatility throughout the next week, mainly due to corrections in high-caps. They said short-term speculators would also add to market volatility.

Independent indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, went down 2.5 percent to 3,496.8 points, and BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, fell by 2.9 percent to 2,518.99. Both indices are based on average prices.
Market star Romcim cement maker closed 1,000 lei firmer at 72,000 in lively trading and a special deal.
Oil refineries stayed in the limelight, with Arpechim closing flat at 24,500, and Petromidia and Petrobrazi ending 2,500 and 1,000 lei weaker at 19,500 and 27,000 respectively.

Wire maker Ductil, a top performer in a special trade on Thursday, recorded a special trade on Friday which boosted its turnover but depressed its price by 100 lei to 1,500. Traders said the deal had involved around one million shares.
